title: Chapter 385 The History Of The World
content:
Chapter 385 The History Of The World

The world Wang Shuo came to.

A long time ago, there was only one country, called the Valandia Empire.

The land under the empire was called the Valandia Continent by them.

Around the empire, there were countless worlds shrouded in fog.

As more and more foggy worlds were transformed into novice trial spaces.

The area of the empire continued to increase, and the emergence of each novice trial space would be accompanied by war.

Countless years later, the territory of the empire was too vast to control, so the Valandia Empire fell apart and became three empires.

The Vanadis Empire, the Kingdom of Pula, and the North Sea Empire.

Later, the North Sea Empire was destroyed again and split into countless empires.

Although the number of empires was increasing, the territory was constantly expanding because new trial spaces continued to appear.

At the same time, the destroyed empires would be swallowed up by the foggy world and transformed into trial spaces again.

After the fall of the North Sea Empire, countless countries such as the Shenwu Empire, the Varangian Empire, the Ghana Dynasty, the Kushan Empire, Mininia, Badandia, and the Truni Empire appeared on the original territory.

Among them, the Great Locust Domain is adjacent to the Shenwu Empire and the Varangian Empire created by the monster.

After reading this, Wang Shuo has a certain understanding of the history of the entire continent.

Opposite the Great Wall of Steel are several city lord forces that were born in the Shenwu Empire a few years ago, as well as the Varangian Empire of the monster.

Facing these old forces, Wang Shuo can't help but worry a little. Can the Great Locust Domain withstand their attack this time?

In the library, Wang Shuo has already met dozens of generals from the Shenwu Empire. The strength of the Shenwu Empire is so strong that it is almost boundless.

The Shenwu Empire adopts a feudal system, that is, you can also establish a country in the empire and become a vassal state or a vassal state.

There are countless countries in the Shenwu Empire. Ordinary people don’t know how many countries there are, because there are constant wars between these countries.

Wang Shuo saw this information and rubbed his head, feeling a little headache.

If he also hid here forever, would he be far away from those troubles?

Wang Shuo fell into confusion.

In front of countless huge empires, he seemed so small.

Such days lasted for about a month.

Wang Shuo also practiced several formations such as the circle formation, the crane wing formation, and the sharp arrow formation to the intermediate level. If he wanted to practice to the advanced level, first, it would take a lot of time. Secondly, Wang Shuo and others had the same idea and wanted to learn all the skills and martial arts here. Even if they were not proficient, they had to at least get started.

One day, Wang Shuo suddenly heard the voice of Lord Zak.

[Wang Shuo, Shura War General Tower is not a place for you to sink. ]

The bead that fell from the Earth Mother Insect Emperor on Wang Shuo's body suddenly flew out of the backpack.

Floating in the air, it then broke into a soft mist and flowed into Wang Shuo's body.

The several formations that Wang Shuo practiced were immediately upgraded to the advanced level.

[You have obtained the qualification to enter the fourth floor. 】

Wang Shuo was immediately teleported to a new secret room.

【Wang Shuo, as long as you pass the fourth level, you can get the title of Shura General, but I changed my mind temporarily. The war of the Iron Great Wall is about to start. You return by yourself and lead the Great Huai Territory to win this war. Then you will pass the Shura General Tower. 】

【Mandatory task: defend the Iron Great Wall. 】

Before Wang Shuo could react, he was teleported back to the Lord's Mansion in Wana County.

It took three months, and Wang Shuo seemed to have had a dream.
